_comment: Per-suit corrections to suit_bundle.select_dressed: key '<id>:<suit>', 'include' re-adds stub roots the rules dropped, 'exclude' drops roots the rules kept (root names as printed by suit_bundle.py / export_suits.py). Decided by looking at the previews.

c01:student._why: the stub ships a black and a white pair for the same legs; the black pair is the game's default

c01:prisoner._why: PrisonClothes is a cropped top that leaves the chest bare, the rings are visible

d01:sm._why: SMBra is an open harness, the nipple covers are part of the look

e01:nurse._why: NurseCloth is open at the chest, the band-aid crosses show

e01:latex._why: four states of one garment; LatexLeotardOpen is the fully closed leotard (compared all three renders)

j01:stewardess._why: ShirtOpen / braUp are the opened and pulled-up states of whiteShirt / bra

k01:2025xmas._why: two eye masks on the same face; the fluffy one belongs to this outfit
